description: RFC 8620 §5.6: total MUST be omitted from /queryChanges response unless calculateTotal=true. All three queryChanges handlers (Email, Mailbox, EmailSubmission) unconditionally include "total": result.total in the JSON object. A client checking absence of total to detect whether the server calculated it will be misled. Fix: read calculateTotal from args in each queryChanges handler and gate the total field the same way the /query handlers do.
title: queryChanges always emits total field
